name: Europium tetratelluride
equilibrium_context: Incommensurate charge density wave with polar, symmetry-breaking charge order and colossal thermal hysteresis extending well above room temperature
summary: The only room-temperature case in the CDW domain - but mechanistically the most strongly thermally contaminated.

driven_states.emergent_property: Non-volatile, reversible switching of the electronic polar order at room temperature. Each state produced changes the resistance and the second-harmonic intensity; hidden metastable CDW configurations that are thermally inaccessible become available.
driven_states.caveat: Candid: the authors themselves cite photoinduced thermal effects as an essential part of the mechanism - the switching exploits the colossal hysteresis and is not purely electronic. The structure of the switched configurations is characterized only via second harmonic and resistance.
driven_states.quenchable_by: a second laser pulse of different fluence, temperature cycling through the hysteresis

gaps: Thermal contribution to the mechanism conceded by the authors themselves.

provenance.notes: Literature search and field extraction by AI agents under the direction of D. Leonforte; every numerical value and citation checked against the cited work and every DOI verified. Not reviewed by a domain expert. Corrections are welcome and are the intended path to improvement.
